_note: Backdrop biome profiles. Each biome defines the scenic parallax backdrop drawn behind the world by scripts/world/world_backdrop.gd (cosmetic; never collides or saves). A biome lists an opaque full-frame `sky` plus an ordered back-to-front `layers` set (each a horizontally-tiling RGBA strip). Adding a biome = a new entry here + its art from `python scripts/art/gen_backgrounds.py` (which reads this file for ids/sizes) + a validator pass (validate_repo.py loops these layers). `default_biome` is used until world-gen selects one per world. Anchors: `horizon` = strip bottom sits on the terrain horizon; `sky` = strip top sits `anchor_y` px below the view top.
